requirements:
This model describes a file system.
It represents oily system elements which can be a folders or files. All file system elements have a name. Every file system element must belong to a folder, and folders can aggregate any number of file system elements. Files have information about their extension and their size.

issues.message: Redundant and conflicting relationships: The model defines both composition and aggregation between Folder and FileSystemElement, and an additional association 'belongs to'.

suggestions: Keep only the composition relationship between Folder and FileSystemElement to represent the 'contains' relationship, and remove the redundant association and aggregation.
